title: Apex Telemetry
description: A GT3 pit board on the center screen: tyre pressures and temperatures against the car's targets, engine temperatures, oil pressure, AFR, timing, boost, gearbox, fuel, range and g-force

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle._optional: the car's pressure and temperature units, for the tyres

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.TPMS._optional: tyre pressures, temperatures and the car's target pressures

config._comment: Tyre colours: TPMS temperature is the air inside the tyre, not the tread: blue under tyreCold, green, amber within 15 °C of tyreHot, red from tyreHot. Pressure against the car's own target (TPMS statusTargetTyrePressure): within 1 psi green, 3 psi amber, else red; without a target, a tyre more than 2 psi off the other side of its axle says UNEVEN.

dme.comment: Boost from the engine unit (DME, ecu 18) over read-only UDS 0x22, only while the sport display sends no boost and a boost readout is shown. Absolute kPa, the outside air pressure (baro) is subtracted. Candidates tried in order, the first plausible one wins. From cauliflowermossgrape's car_vitals (MIT). Intake air temperature the same way (config.dme.intake, every 2 s, only while an intake readout shows); candidates from cruzen991/Cluster's signal table (MIT), unverified on this car. Oil pressure (config.dme.oilPressure, absolute bar; the outside air pressure from baro is subtracted), AFR (config.dme.afr, lambda x 14.7) and the first intake / baro candidates: BMW's own DME8FF_R identifiers, as cauliflowermossgrape's Live Data reads them; the OBD ones stay as fallbacks. egs: gearbox oil temperature from the gearbox unit (EGS, ecu 24), as M Vitals reads it (cauliflowermossgrape, MIT), asked only while the basic data set has none.

boost.note: OBD PID 0x70 boost pressure control: actual boost pressure sensor A (absolute), 1/32 kPa
OBD PID 0x87 intake manifold absolute pressure sensor A, 1/32 kPa
OBD PID 0x0B intake manifold absolute pressure, kPa (max 255 = 1.5 bar boost)

baro.note: IPUMG, ambient pressure, u16 x 0.0390625 hPa -> kPa. DME8FF_R (MG1 DME: B58 / B48 / B38, G series), the identifiers cauliflowermossgrape's Live Data reads (MIT)
OBD PID 0x33 barometric pressure, kPa (101.3 when not available)

intake.note: ITANS, intake air temperature, u8 x 0.75 - 48 C. DME8FF_R (MG1 DME: B58 / B48 / B38, G series), the identifiers cauliflowermossgrape's Live Data reads (MIT)
OBD PID 0x0F intake air temperature, C + 40
OBD PID 0x77 charge air cooler temperature, bank 1 sensor 1 (byte after the support byte), C + 40

timing.note: OBD service 01 PID 0x0E timing advance, degrees before TDC (cylinder 1); the candidates M Vitals (cauliflowermossgrape, MIT) reads

afr.note: ILAG1, lambda actual bank 1, u16 x 1/4096, times 14.7 for gasoline AFR. DME8FF_R (MG1 DME: B58 / B48 / B38, G series), the identifiers cauliflowermossgrape's Live Data reads (MIT)
LAMBDA_SONDE_IST, lambda from the probe, as 5889. DME8FF_R (MG1 DME: B58 / B48 / B38, G series), the identifiers cauliflowermossgrape's Live Data reads (MIT)
OBD PID 0x34 wide-range O2 sensor bank 1 sensor 1: equivalence ratio (lambda) 2/65536 per bit, times 14.7 for gasoline AFR. Unverified on this car.
OBD PID 0x24 O2 sensor 1: equivalence ratio, as F434

oilPressure.note: I_DRUCK_OEL_IST_ABS, oil pressure actual (absolute), u16 hPa -> bar. DME8FF_R (MG1 DME: B58 / B48 / B38, G series), the identifiers cauliflowermossgrape's Live Data reads (MIT)
OELDRUCK, oil pressure, s16 hPa -> bar (absolute, as Live Data reads it). DME8FF_R (MG1 DME: B58 / B48 / B38, G series), the identifiers cauliflowermossgrape's Live Data reads (MIT)

egs.note: ZF 8HP (GSZFBCE) _GETRIEBEOELTEMPERATUR, deg C + 40 (idrive7-apps PR #29, read on a G22)
gearbox unit (EGS, 0x18) transmission oil temperature, deg C + 48 (from a forum report, not confirmed on a car: only shown once it changes; the replies go to the log, "raw EGS")
